Kimsuky (aka Velvet Chollima), a North Korean state-sponsored threat actor, has been attributed to cyber attacks targeting South Korean military and corporate entities in March and April 2026. Kaspersky disclosed that Kimsuky leveraged VS Code tunneling, Cloudflare Quick Tunnels, DWAgent, and LLMs in campaigns affecting various sectors in South Korea, with malware families including PebbleDash (HelloDoor, HttpMalice, HttpTroy) and AppleSeed variants. The AppleSeed cluster is reported to be shifting focus to data exfiltration with GPKI certificate extraction as a signature capability.
